tactics.title: Tactics Library
tactics.description: Explore our collection of FM26 tactics — each with complete player roles, team instructions, and performance breakdown. Find the perfect system for your squad.
tactics.introText1: Welcome to the FM26 Tactics Library — the complete database of Football Manager 2026 tactics and formations. Every system below is broken down with full player roles, team instructions, and a performance overview, so you can find the best FM26 tactic for your squad. Whether you want to press high with a gegenpress, control games with tiki-taka, or frustrate opponents on the counter-attack, there is a proven blueprint here for every style of play.
tactics.introText2: New to the game? Start with the 4-2-3-1 gegenpress or the balanced 4-4-2 wing play — both are widely considered the best FM26 tactics for beginners. Experienced managers can explore the meta 4-3-3 systems or the deep 3-5-2 shapes, and every tactic page explains exactly how to set it up, which roles to use, and how the system performs against the FM26 match engine.
tactics.builderCtaText: Don't see the perfect system? Use our free interactive FM26 Tactic Builder to create a custom formation in minutes — place players, assign roles and duties, and export your tactic for Football Manager 2026.

roles.title: Player Roles Encyclopedia
roles.description: Complete reference for every FM26 player role — attributes, duties, and tactical fit.
roles.wkNote: FM26 mid-season database · fees vary with your save
roles.tryThisRoleDesc: Add {role} to your custom tactic using our interactive builder.

roleDesc.sweeper-keeper: A goalkeeper who sweeps up balls behind the defensive line and initiates counter-attacks with long distribution.
roleDesc.goalkeeper: The standard goalkeeper role. Stays between the sticks, organizes the defense, and makes saves.
roleDesc.ball-playing-defender: A center-back who builds play from the back with accurate passing and composure under pressure.
roleDesc.central-defender: The traditional no-nonsense defender. Wins aerial duels and makes crucial tackles.
roleDesc.full-back: Balanced wide defender who supports both attack and defense from the flanks.
roleDesc.wing-back: An attacking-minded wide player who provides the main source of width in formations without wingers.
roleDesc.deep-lying-playmaker: A midfield orchestrator who dictates tempo from deep positions with incisive passing range.
roleDesc.box-to-box-midfielder: An energetic midfielder who contributes at both ends of the pitch with relentless running.
roleDesc.advanced-playmaker: The creative hub operating between the lines, threading through balls and unlocking defenses.
roleDesc.inside-forward: Cuts inside from wide positions to score goals, acting more like a striker than a traditional winger.
roleDesc.advanced-forward: The primary goal-scoring outlet who plays on the shoulder of the last defender.
roleDesc.pressing-forward: A defensive forward who harasses opposition defenders and forces mistakes high up the pitch.
roleDesc.target-forward: A physical presence who holds up the ball and brings teammates into play with knock-downs and layoffs.
roleDesc.line-holding-keeper: A traditional goalkeeper introduced in FM26 who holds his line and stays deep — ideal for defences that sit back and protect the box.
roleDesc.overlapping-centre-back: A FM26 centre-back role for three-at-the-back systems who steps out and overlaps on the flank, adding an extra body in the final third.
roleDesc.playmaking-wing-back: The advanced FM26 wing-back role that drifts inside to dictate play, creating overloads while the wide forward stretches the pitch.
roleDesc.channel-midfielder: A new FM26 midfielder who attacks the half-spaces between the lines, arriving late in the box and combining between midfield and attack.

sweeper-keeper: Elite shot-stopping with 15+ Reflexes and calm distribution — the archetypal sweeper keeper for a high line.
Modern sweeper keeper who excels at sweeping behind a high line and starting attacks with long passes.
Top-tier reactions and 1v1s with genuine command of the area — ready-made for the top leagues now.
goalkeeper: Outstanding Reflexes and Handling for his age — a traditional shot-stopper who will anchor a defence for a decade.
The best young pure goalkeeper in the database — elite reactions, aerial command and penalty saves.
ball-playing-defender: Elite Anticipation and Composure on the ball — the best young ball-playing CB in the game.
16+ Acceleration in a 6'3 frame with genuine passing range — carries the ball out and recovers instantly.
Progresses the ball with real pace and still dominates duels — the complete modern defender at a fair price.
central-defender: Combines recovery pace with 17+ Jumping Reach — shuts down both the aerial game and the ball over the top.
6'4, cheap and dominant in the air — the budget rock of any back line.
Elite positioning and recovery speed make him the rare young CB who thrives in a high defensive line.
full-back: A workhorse with 15+ Work Rate and Stamina who overlaps all day and still recovers — the complete full-back.
High-energy, cheap and tactically flexible — provides the attacking width a narrow system needs.
A natural left-sided CB with 15+ Acceleration — defends the space behind while still joining the attack.
wing-back: 16+ Work Rate and Stamina — owns the entire flank alone for 90 minutes, both directions.
The attacking wing-back profile — relentless overlapping runs with the engine to recover afterwards.
A dribbling, crossing left-sided wing-back — elite set pieces and deliveries from the flank.
deep-lying-playmaker: 16+ Passing and First Touch — the deep metronome who turns defence into attack with one pass over the press.
An 18-year-old ball carrier who beats the first press phase — the deepest value in young playmakers.
Positionally mature beyond his years with elite scanning — screens the back line and dictates tempo.
box-to-box-midfielder: 15+ Work Rate and Stamina with elite technicals — presses for 90 minutes and still arrives in the box.
18+ Work Rate and press-resistant ball-carrying — the definition of the modern box-to-box engine.
Carries the ball through midfield transitions with elite composure — the link between defence and attack.
advanced-playmaker: 16+ Technique and elite first touch between the lines — turns half-chances into goals from the #10 slot.
16 Passing, 17 Vision at 21 — the best young playmaker outside the elite clubs, and affordable.
A 17-year-old creative engine with elite Flair — the most exciting young #10 to emerge from South America.
inside-forward: Generational — elite Acceleration and dribbling, the highest-potential player in FM26. Cut inside and finish.
17+ Acceleration and Dribbling with a genuine goal threat — the classic modern inside forward.
A lethal left-footed wide talent who cuts inside onto his stronger foot — the affordable elite option.
advanced-forward: 17+ Acceleration and Finishing — times his runs onto through balls better than any young striker.
A one-touch finisher with 16+ Acceleration — the lone striker who turns one chance into a goal.
Strong, quick enough and a natural finisher — a 25-goal-a-season number 9 in the making.
pressing-forward: Relentless from-the-front pressure with the finishing to punish the mistakes he forces.
Chases every lost cause and still scores 20+ — the perfect pressing-forward profile for a gegenpress.
Genuine pace and direct running — the budget pressing forward who turns regains into goals.
target-forward: 6'5 with 17 Jumping Reach and Heading — the delivery target who wins every aerial duel and scores the knockdowns.
A powerful 6'4 target man with genuine pace — pinches defenders, holds the ball up and finishes the flick-ons.
Drops deep to link play and wins the knockdowns — a modern target man who creates for the runner beside him.
line-holding-keeper: Huge 6'7 frame, elite Aerial Reach and 15+ Reflexes — a ready-made line-holding wall for a low block.
Outstanding positional sense and 1v1s; holds his line beautifully when the defence sits deep.
Calm, commanding and consistent — top-tier Handling and Command of Area for a settled back five.
overlapping-centre-back: Rapid, reads the game superbly and carries the ball out — the modern overlapping CB for a back three.
Left-footed, composed and quick — steps out of a back three to overlap and deliver crosses.
Comfortable stepping forward with the ball and superb at recovering on the cover.
playmaking-wing-back: Left-sided and technically gifted — glides inside to dictate play and overlaps relentlessly.
Excellent stamina and crossing; the archetypal attacking playmaking wing-back for a 3-5-2.
Explosive on the overlap with sharp passing — drives into the final third and picks out cutbacks.
channel-midfielder: Bursts into the half-spaces, arrives late and can finish — the definition of a channel runner.
Press-resistant with a wand of a first touch; glides between the lines and links midfield to attack.
Exceptional balance and passing in tight spaces — thrives on the half-turn in the channels.
